items.title: 5.1 Classification of solids (solids ki qismein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.1 with the chapter's opening paragraph (PDF 93-95).

blocks.text: Har material ka apna khaas istemal hota hai, jo us ki properties (khoobiyon) par depend karta hai, jaise hardness (sakhti), ductility (taar ban sakne ki ability) aur malleability (chadar ban sakne ki ability). Steel sakht aur lead (seesa) naram kyun hai? Is ka jawab material ki structure (banawat) mein hai: atoms aur molecules kis tarteeb mein hain aur aapas mein kaise jure (bonded) hain. Isi tarah behte hue fluids (liquids aur gases) ka study mushkil hai, lekin kuch assumptions (farz ki hui baatein) maan kar ise aasaan kiya ja sakta hai. Do conservation principles (kisi cheez ke qaim rehne ke qaide) is ko aur aasaan banate hain: mass ka conservation aur energy ka conservation. Mass ke conservation se equation of continuity milti hai, aur energy ka conservation Bernoulli's theorem ki base (bunyad) hai.

Crystalline solids mein atoms aur molecules ek regular tarteeb mein hote hain. Har molecule ke parosi (neighbours) ek hi pattern mein lage hote hain, aur yeh pattern poore crystal mein ek jaisa rehta hai. Is liye crystalline solids ki structure ordered (tarteeb wali) hoti hai.

Zyada tar solids, jaise metals aur ceramics, crystalline hote hain, yani un ke atoms, molecules ya ions ek regular pattern mein hote hain. Yeh tarteeb X-ray Diffraction (XRD) aur Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) jaisi techniques se dekhi ja sakti hai. Yaad rahe ke crystal ke atoms ruke hue (static) nahi hote: har atom ek fixed point ke gird vibrate karta (thartharata) hai, aur temperature barhne se is vibration ka amplitude (jhoolne ki had) barhta hai. Atoms ki average jagahein hi lambe faaslon tak bilkul tarteeb mein hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Ek jaise gulabi oval (ande jaisa lamba gol) hisson ke do jaal (networks), chhote gol jor par mile hue. Oopar: hisse regular chhe-kone chhalle (hexagonal rings) banate hain jo poori tasveer mein qataron mein dohraye jate hain. Neeche: har hissa ab bhi parosiyon se jura hai, lekin chhallon ki shakal aur size alag alag hai aur koi pattern nahi dohrata.
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 94): Glassy aur crystalline solid, chhote aur lambe faasle ki tarteeb (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wala jaal crystalline solid hai: har jagah wahi chhalla (ring) dohraya jata hai, yani tarteeb door door tak qaim hai (long-range order). Neeche wala glassy (amorphous) solid hai: har hissa apne qareebi parosiyon se usi tarah jura hai (short-range order), lekin thore faasle ke baad tarteeb toot jati hai.

Crystalline solids mein atoms, molecules ya ions ke beech cohesive forces (aapas mein jor kar rakhne wali forces) vibrations ke bawajood lambe faasle ki sakht tarteeb (long-range order) qaim rakhti hain. Lekin har crystal ke liye ek aisa temperature hota hai jahan vibrations itni barh jati hain ke structure achanak toot jati hai aur solid pighal (melt ho) jata hai. Is liye solid (tarteeb) se liquid (disorder) mein badalna achanak (abrupt) hota hai. Har crystalline solid ka ek definite melting point hota hai, maslan quartz, calcite, cheeni (sugar), mica aur heera (diamond).

Amorphous ka matlab hai “baghair shakal ya structure ke”. Amorphous solids mein molecules ki crystalline solids jaisi regular tarteeb nahi hoti. Is liye keh sakte hain ke amorphous solids un liquids jaise hain jin ki be-tarteeb structure jam (freeze ho) gayi ho.

Misal: aam sheesha (glass) aam temperature par solid hai lekin us ke molecules ki koi regular tarteeb nahi. Garam karne par yeh aahista aahista naram ho kar paste jaisa banta hai, aur taqreeban 800°C par bohat gaarha (viscous) liquid ban jata hai. Isi liye amorphous solids ko glassy solids bhi kehte hain. In ka koi fixed melting point nahi hota, maslan plastic, glass aur fused silica.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne glassy solid ki misal “fused silicon” likhi hai. Sahi lafz fused silica (fused quartz, SiO₂) hai; silicon khud ek crystalline element hai, glassy solid nahi.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf, Crystalline solids: ek jaisi neeli-hari gendein seedhi rows aur columns mein, khali jagahon mein doosri layer nazar aati hai. Daen taraf, Amorphous solids: wahi gendein baghair kisi regular tarteeb ke bikhri hui, beech na-barabar faasle.
blocks.caption: Crystalline solids aur amorphous solids (PDF page 94) (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Polymers aise solid materials hain jin ki structure tarteeb (order) aur disorder (be-tarteeb hona) ke beech mein hoti hai; inhen partially (kuch had tak) ya poorly (kam) crystalline solids kehte hain. Polymers natural aur insaan ke banaye (synthetic) materials ka bara group hain. Plastics aur synthetic rubbers ko polymers is liye kehte hain ke yeh polymerization reactions se bante hain: in reactions mein chhote saade molecules chemical taur par jur kar bohat lambi zanjeer (long chain) wale molecules ya teen-dimensional (3D) structures banate hain. In materials ki specific gravity (pani ke muqable density) halki se halki metal se bhi kam hoti hai, phir bhi in ki strength-to-weight ratio (wazan ke hisaab se strength) achhi hoti hai.

Polymers poore ya kuch hisse mein carbon ke oxygen, hydrogen, nitrogen aur doosre metallic ya non-metallic elements ke saath chemical combination (milap) se bante hain. Polythene, polystyrene aur nylon polymers ki misalein hain. Pure (khalis) natural rubber poora ek hydrocarbon hai jis ka formula (C₅H₈)ₙ hai.

blocks.alt: PVC zanjeer (chain) ke ek hisse ka ball-and-stick drawing: chaar carbon atoms (C) zigzag mein, dono siron par bond aage jate hain. Pehle aur teesre carbon par do do hydrogen atoms (H); doosre aur chauthe par ek hydrogen aur ek chlorine atom (Cl).

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa polymer hai: wool (oon), glass, sodium chloride ya copper? Glass ka fixed melting point kyun nahi jabke quartz ka hai?
blocks.explanation: Wool ek natural protein polymer hai; glass amorphous hai, sodium chloride aur copper crystalline hain. Quartz ki lambe faasle tak ki tarteeb ek khaas temperature par achanak toot jati hai, is liye us ka fixed melting point hai. Glass ki be-tarteeb structure garmi se aahista aahista dheeli hoti hai, is liye woh ek range mein naram hota hai aur phir behne lagta hai.

items: Crystalline: regular, lambe faasle tak tarteeb (XRD, TEM se dekhi jati hai); atoms fixed points ke gird vibrate karte hain; fixed melting point (quartz, calcite, cheeni, mica, heera).
Amorphous (glassy): disorder jami hui; koi fixed melting point nahi; aahista naram hota hai (glass, plastic, fused silica).
Polymeric: tarteeb aur disorder ke beech; polymerization se lambi zanjeerein; kam specific gravity magar achhi strength (polythene, polystyrene, nylon, PVC, rubber (C₅H₈)ₙ).
